description: A part's or an assembly's configurations, by name, and which one is active. feature.suppress and dimension.set act in a part's active configuration; component.set and the component's state in an assembly's.

document.description: The part or assembly: its title, its full path, or its file name with the extension (e.g. part.SLDPRT, part.SLDDRW), which picks exactly that document. A name several open documents share is refused with the candidates. The active document when absent.
